liquidity_sweep.definition: Causal wick beyond last confirmed swing high/low then close back inside. Bullish: low < swing_low AND close > swing_low AND close >= open. Bearish: high > swing_high AND close < swing_high AND close <= open.

fvg.definition: Strict 3-candle FVG at bar i: bullish if low[i] > high[i-2]; bearish if high[i] < low[i-2]. Mitigation tracked forward only.
fvg.active: fresh OR partial (partial touch of zone without full mitigation)

frozen_specification.sweep_fvg_sequence: Entry bar i when (fresh OR partial FVG active at i) AND liquidity sweep occurred within bars i-0..i-3 (fvg_after_sweep_*).

daily_htf_alignment.definition: Completed Daily structure class at 4H timestamp t via _htf_class: swing_structure_dir on daily bars with pivot=2 AND ADX(14) >= ADX_WEAK. Bullish E3 requires daily_class==1; bearish requires daily_class==-1.
daily_htf_alignment.note: V13 causal audit verifies whether incomplete current-day OHLC leaks.

frozen_specification.entry_timing: Signal bar close (4H close). Adverse entry slippage only in stress tests.

htf_look_ahead.mechanism: aggregate_daily() builds full-day OHLC from all 4H bars of the UTC day; _htf_class(daily, t) selects that day's bar when t is mid-day, so high/low/close (and thus ADX/swing structure) can incorporate later 4H bars of the same day.
htf_look_ahead.passthrough_requirement: At 4H timestamp t, Daily HTF must use only fully completed days before t (exclude the in-progress UTC day).
